title: Force an old input coefficient to change on the funded chart-268 graph
body:
## Result

On the funded chart-268 graph from #8008, at least one old coefficient among inputs {22, 51, 77, 91, 92, 96, 97, 98, 100} must change in a full repair satisfying the stated projection on the new contacts. Permit changes to the other 671 coefficients in every retained paid value and grant each sender every eventual arrival at its chart. The direct return has old 3410’s projection on those nine inputs and the new 0→19 value has zero projection there. The target owner map and charts stay fixed.

The verifier handles all eight owner-679 helper histories. Four fail at chart 421, and the other four each give a 655-node exact affine contradiction. It also synthesizes three incomplete one-coordinate release controls. A grade-five 19→421 relaxation gives all 680 forward and 680 adjoint rows at a 36-call BIT margin about −178.7246586664. The funded topology’s +0.1548121757 tariff lacks a complete operator. The separate rational margin at 0.00388 is +0.1389745223. The proof neither excludes releases outside the nine-coordinate contract nor establishes a new κ.

## Replay

Archive SHA-256 `dc2706a13934ce1f8cb2c902c1e5aa9a5d36f633dcbb08a5e5e54a96e0ad1bca`. A fresh extraction passed `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and `python3 -I -B verify.py`, including both pinned source orientations and all named cases.

## Prior and parallel work

#8008 `3c211525087ba8fed1f34e329ff9de095ac133a1` isolates the funded topology. This argument follows #8014 `e21cc2ec5e7175f1e7bf24f8d8107531ad461b47` and #8015 `b8f7adb79fde8c992d0f0f2a2ad6be83778df89c` and scopes the additional freedom needed beyond the earlier planes. The full endpoint-rebind control changes the owner charts in a separate package. Finding a causal, funded recode outside this projection and qualifying the outer application remain open.
